reviews.title: It’s a trap!
reviews.text: I signed up for the free trial. Afterward, I attempted to cancel the subscription because I knew I wouldn’t use it much to justify paying for it. I have requested to cancel multiple times now, and still no response from their customer service. It’s 4 months later and they’re still charging my credit card and ignoring my cancel requests. I will have to take other actions. It sucks, because while the platform is awesome, their customer service is horrible and totally non-existent.

reviews.title: Recently ruined by barrage of loud repetitive commercials
reviews.text: Used to be one of my favorite for podcasts and audiobooks. However, recent barrage of new commercials, primarily sports betting, has made using the app almost unusable. Commercials come on, and often repeat themselves, so you’re listening to the same commercial three or four times at the start of a podcast, or if you happen to stop and then restart the podcast the same commercials repeat. You cannot skip them. And also, the volume for the commercials is significantly louder than the podcast, which is jarring. Gonna have to find another audiobook if they can’t sort out the issues with the commercial soon.

reviews.title: Horrible Customer Service
reviews.text: Once you upgrade your service you aren’t allowed to downgrade to a cheaper plan. You have to completely delete your account and all content and start over. Sometimes when my cohost and I record, we can’t hear the other person in the playback as well. It’s been discouraging and we are looking to leave Podbean and use a different service. I’ve paid for an upgrade twice, one is $40 a month and I still don’t have enough credits to do AI editing each time.

reviews.title: This app has really gone downhill in the last few years
reviews.text: I have been using this app for years, and it has really gone downhill lately.  Now it has ads in the user interface even if you pay the annual subscription fee.  It doesn’t handle basic functionality well, such as letting you manage when episodes get downloaded.  It’s a pain when you discover new podcasts that already have a lot of old episodes.  There are features that simply don’t work.  I think I will have to find a new alternative and set up all my subscriptions from scratch, because this app just isn’t worth it anymore.

reviews.title: Worthless if you value cybersecurity
reviews.text:
Like many other apps lately, this one has gone down the user-hating road of not working while you are connected to a VPN. No episodes will play, insist you download them, but when you try, the download inexplicably fails to even start. 
How dare you try and maintain some semblance of security or safety online while listening to a podcast!   And of course they aren’t interested in telling you that in any of the error messages, that’s on you to figure out because you had the audacity to try and shield yourself from prying eyes on networks you don’t trust with everything. 

Ridiculous trend.

reviews.title: Old episodes deleted after 30 days
reviews.text:
My account was inactive for 30 days so all of my podcasts were erased permanently. Support said:

“the episode audio files were automatically removed 30 days after the account was locked. This is based on the account lock duration and is not related to file size”

Pathetic from a hosting site! Make them inactive, they’re mp3s? Why delete them? Going to host elsewhere.

reviews.title: Rip off
reviews.text: Annual subscription has effectively doubled to just under £20 a year. What features have been added to justify this hike in cost? Absolutely none! It goes without saying that I am not willing to be treated like a mug so have cancelled my subscription. I’ll be looking for a new podcast app. Nice work podbean developers, hope you get the change in subscribers that you deserve…
